limitations: Only two synthetic task families, seeded acceptance definitions, one final native run per arm; no statistical latency/quality superiority conclusion.
Neutral filler stresses context and compaction but does not recreate all semantic complexity of a real 75-round/2058-step task.
Q8 is asynchronous hybrid retrieval; some cold queries fall back to lexical, and maxRecords is not a cap on complete native history or process RAM.
A raw evidence journal limit of 32768 can conservatively invalidate evidence older than the retained window; no unlimited-history guarantee.
The near-1M phases reserve only 4096 main output tokens; additional probes restore the native 256000 reservation.
No QQ/Feishu sends, real deployment, real article fetching, or new browser UI validation in this round.
